nodes.label: Central Bank Policy Rate
nodes.description: Interbank headline target rate set by the monetary authority to control inflation and liquidity.

nodes.label: Headline & Core CPI Inflation
nodes.description: Macroeconomic purchasing power erosion and consumer basket price escalation rate.

nodes.label: Global Crude Oil & Energy
nodes.description: Upstream commodity benchmark price impacting transport, logistics, and power utility costs.

nodes.label: Geopolitical Conflict & Border Risk
nodes.description: Military escalations, strait blockades, sovereign sanctions, and global instability index.

nodes.label: Fiscal Policy & Government Spending
nodes.description: Sovereign budget initiatives, tax incentives, infrastructure appropriations, and deficit programs.

nodes.label: Tech Breakthrough & AI Boom
nodes.description: Structural enterprise productivity enhancements, algorithmic automation, and semiconductor innovations.

nodes.label: Climate Disruption & Seasonal Shock
nodes.description: Monsoon variations, severe polar freezes, agricultural crop yields, and renewable grid disruption.

nodes.label: Banking Solvency & Liquidity Stress
nodes.description: Interbank counterparty distrust, deposit outflows, credit spread widening, and reserve shortfalls.

nodes.label: Trade Tariffs & Import Barriers
nodes.description: Protectionist import duties, technology export bans, and supply-chain onshoring mandates.

nodes.label: Pandemic & Mobility Freeze
nodes.description: Biosecurity emergencies, lockdown orders, hospitality halts, and border travel restrictions.

nodes.label: Digital Asset Regulatory Enforcement
nodes.description: Centralized exchange compliance orders, anti-money laundering licensing, and institutional liquidity oversight.

nodes.label: Corporate & Interbank Borrowing Costs
nodes.description: Commercial paper and prime lending borrowing rates paid by firms to finance leverage.

nodes.label: Equity Discount Rate (WACC)
nodes.description: Hurdle rate used in Discounted Cash Flow models to price future earnings of high-duration assets.

nodes.label: Household Disposable Demand
nodes.description: Real purchasing power available for non-essential discretionary and staple goods.

nodes.label: Corporate CAPEX & Enterprise Budgets
nodes.description: Long-term capital expenditures on data centers, infrastructure, facilities, and fleet expansions.

nodes.label: Industrial Energy Input Costs
nodes.description: Feedstock fuel and power utility tariffs absorbed across heavy industry and transport.

nodes.label: Supply Chain & Freight Logistics
nodes.description: Container freight rates, customs wait times, and component lead times.

nodes.label: Bank Credit & Loan Origination
nodes.description: Commercial bank lending willingness, debt underwriting volume, and money supply velocity.

nodes.label: Rural & Agricultural Output
nodes.description: Farm harvest yields and domestic rural consumption capacity.

nodes.label: Sovereign Benchmark Yield Curve
nodes.description: Risk-free sovereign term premium on short and 10-year sovereign obligations.

nodes.label: Flight-to-Safety Capital Flows
nodes.description: Institutional rebalancing from volatile risk assets into anti-fragile hedges.

nodes.label: Corporate Net Profit Margins (EBITDA)
nodes.description: Aggregate bottom-line profitability after taxes, energy, and debt servicing.

nodes.label: Mortgage Rates & Property Demand
nodes.description: Residential and commercial real estate financing rates and buyer capitalization rates.

nodes.label: Information Technology
nodes.description: High-growth software, semiconductor, enterprise cloud, and hardware producers.

nodes.label: Banking & Financial Services
nodes.description: Deposit-taking banks, investment firms, lending institutions, and asset managers.

nodes.label: Energy & Utilities
nodes.description: Oil & gas extraction, power utilities, renewable grid providers, and pipelines.

nodes.label: FMCG & Consumer Staples
nodes.description: Defensive consumer goods, food, beverage, household necessities, and agriculture.

nodes.label: Healthcare & Pharmaceuticals
nodes.description: Pharmaceuticals, biotech, hospitals, medical devices, and vaccine developers.

nodes.label: Real Estate & Infrastructure
nodes.description: REITs, commercial property developments, logistics parks, and civil infrastructure.

nodes.label: Broad Equities Basket
nodes.description: Market-weighted composite of all equity sector capitalizations.

nodes.label: Short-Term Sovereign T-Bills
nodes.description: Ultra-low duration sovereign cash proxy with principal preservation.

nodes.label: 10-Year Sovereign Bonds
nodes.description: High-duration sovereign debt vulnerable to rate spikes but resilient in deflation.

nodes.label: Physical Gold Trust
nodes.description: Zero-counterparty-risk monetary hedge against fiat debasement and stagflation.

nodes.label: Physical Silver & Industrial Metals
nodes.description: Hybrid precious and industrial metal benefiting from manufacturing demand.

nodes.label: SGD Money Market Cash
nodes.description: Zero nominal volatility liquid cash reserve earning overnight policy yields.

nodes.label: Digital Asset Benchmark ETF
nodes.description: Speculative high-beta liquidity barometer sensitive to systemic fiat flows.

edges.description: Policy rate hikes directly increase prime and interbank commercial lending rates.
Monetary tightening shifts the benchmark risk-free yield curve upward.
Higher benchmark policy rates immediately pass through to variable and fixed mortgage loans.
Cost of debt escalation elevates the weighted average cost of capital (WACC).
Higher discount rates disproportionately compress P/E multiples of long-duration tech cash flows.
Rising hurdle rates depress real estate capitalization values and net asset valuations.
Mortgage affordability shocks depress homebuyer demand and developer transactions.
Bond duration mechanics: rising yields force immediate capital loss on long-duration sovereign paper.
Short-dated paper rolls over quickly at higher coupon yields with near-zero duration loss.
Modest rate increases expand Net Interest Margins (NIM) between loan assets and deposit liabilities.
Interbank counterparty fear causes lenders to hoard reserves and freeze credit lines.
Credit contractions diminish bank fee income, loan origination volume, and asset quality.
Banking panics trigger emergency capital flight from private balance sheets into physical bullion and sovereign paper.
Flight-to-safety flows drive strong institutional demand for physical gold as an unencumbered hedge.
Investors park liquidity in risk-free sovereign short-term bills to evade credit default risk.
Digital assets rely heavily on speculative liquidity; credit freezes lead to forced deleveraging liquidations.
Maritime choke-point blockades and conflicts immediately curtail global crude availability.
Upstream crude spikes directly expand top-line revenues and operating margins for oil extractors.
Energy price spikes cascade across logistics, manufacturing, and food processing into core consumer inflation.
Elevated fossil fuel prices increase power utility operating costs and transport fuel expenditures.
Gasoline and heating bills crowd out discretionary family spending budgets.
War and geopolitical instability induce defensive flight-to-safety portfolio rotations.
Persistent consumer inflation forces central banks to implement emergency monetary tightening.
High structural inflation accelerates gold's role as a store of purchasing power.
Real purchasing power erosion forces consumers to curb discretionary outlays.
Staples benefit from inelastic demand even when discretionary spending shrinks.
Adequate monsoon rains produce bumper agricultural yields; severe droughts decimate farm output.
Rural farm income is the primary demand driver for domestic FMCG consumer goods.
Severe winter freezes increase heating oil and natural gas demand to critical capacity.
AI breakthroughs and enterprise automation spur explosive software demand and semiconductor orders.
Enterprises aggressively allocate capital toward compute infrastructure and digital transformation.
Long-term automation capex increases structural profit margins and labor efficiency.
Technological optimism frequently spills over into speculative decentralized technology benchmarks.
Punitive import duties create administrative friction and supply bottlenecks at maritime ports.
Semiconductor trade barriers interrupt global hardware assembly and delay device shipments.
Supply chain snarls add import cost surcharges that pass through to consumer retail prices.
Stay-at-home orders shut down physical retail, commercial travel, and entertainment venues.
Health emergencies create surge demand for diagnostic kits, therapeutics, and hospital capacity.
Remote-work mandates drive immediate cloud infrastructure and collaboration software adoption.
Direct sovereign subsidy infusions sponsor major infrastructure, energy transition, and construction works.
Civil infrastructure contracts directly fuel industrial REITs and civil construction revenues.
Tax rebates and direct household subsidies inject immediate spending power into consumer markets.
Green infrastructure funds accelerate renewable energy grid installations and battery storage subsidies.
Strict compliance mandates and enforcement actions trigger immediate institutional liquidity exits.
Aggregate equity market performance tracks structural corporate earnings growth over time.
Information Technology represents a dominant weighting in modern equity indices.
Commercial financials represent a foundational pillar of market capitalization.
Solar PV and electronics manufacturing consume significant industrial physical silver.

EVENT_MONETARY_HIKE.description: Central bank announces aggressive 100bps rate hike to extinguish inflation expectations.

EVENT_RATE_CUT_QE.description: Central banks coordinate 75bps rate cut and inject systemic liquidity via quantitative easing.

EVENT_GEOPOLITICAL_OIL.description: Maritime strait blockade triggers supply shortage and sends crude oil surging.

EVENT_BANK_RUN_PANIC.description: Regional bank failure triggers deposit runs, credit contraction, and flight to safe havens.

EVENT_MONSOON_DEFICIT.description: El Nino weather pattern causes severe monsoon rain shortfall, depressing rural demand.

EVENT_BUMPER_MONSOON.description: Optimal monsoon rains drive record harvests and rural consumer spending surge.

EVENT_TARIFF_CHIPS.description: Punitive import duties on semiconductor chips disrupt technology supply chains.

EVENT_PANDEMIC_LOCKDOWN.description: Global health emergency mandates economic freeze, border closures, and emergency healthcare mobilization.

EVENT_AI_PRODUCTIVITY_BOOM.description: Breakthrough in generative AI drives massive enterprise automation and tech earnings re-rating.

EVENT_SUBSIDY_GREEN.description: Multi-billion dollar sovereign fund announced for renewable energy and clean grid infrastructure.

EVENT_SOVEREIGN_INFRA_INJECTION.description: Sovereign infrastructure injection awards major civil construction and logistics contracts.

EVENT_CORPORATE_TAX_CUT.description: Sweeping corporate income tax cut increases net after-tax corporate profit margins.

EVENT_GST_CONSUMPTION_BOOST.description: Targeted consumption tax rebates and wage adjustments boost disposable retail spending.

EVENT_REAL_ESTATE_COOLING.description: Macroprudential stamp duties and loan-to-value caps cool speculative property price growth.

EVENT_CRYPTO_CRACKDOWN.description: Regulators issue severe restrictions on digital asset exchanges, prompting speculative liquidation.

EVENT_WINTER_ENERGY_FREEZE.description: Unprecedented polar vortex depletes natural gas reserves and drives utility demand higher.

EVENT_SOVEREIGN_DEBT_DOWNGRADE.description: Credit agency downgrades sovereign outlook, raising borrowing spreads and triggering flight to gold.

EVENT_DEFENSE_BUDGET_SURGE.description: Emergency 25% defense appropriation increases industrial spending amid rising geopolitical friction.

EVENT_BIOTECH_FAST_TRACK.description: Regulatory overhaul accelerates life-saving drug approvals and clinical trials.

EVENT_GOLDILOCKS_SOFT_LANDING.description: Inflation cools toward 2% target without triggering a recession, easing discount rates.

EVENT_FREE_TRADE_ACCORD.description: Multilateral free trade pact slashes export duties and streamlines logistics corridors.

EVENT_FISCAL_TAX_LOSS.description: Calendar year-end tax-loss selling triggers short-term institutional equity liquidity dips.
